title: ZTAS-DTh: code and data for a zero-trust security architecture for the digital thread (v1.1.0)
description:
Code, configurations, random seeds, raw and processed data, executed notebooks, bounded model-checking logs, a single-host software proof of concept and its test results accompanying the manuscript ZTAS-DTh: A Lifecycle-Spanning Zero-Trust Security Architecture for the Digital Thread — Design, Bounded Formal Analysis, and Simulation-Based Evaluation.

v1.1.0 adds the second-revision package (revision_v1.1.0/ZTAS-DTh_v1.1.0_revision_package.zip): joint sensitivity analysis over eleven assumed parameters (Latin hypercube, three control regimes, Sobol indices; 612,000 paired simulations); risk-engine evaluation at 0.1–20% prevalence with calibration-transfer and cost-sensitive thresholds; continuous-time evidence-accumulation study (52,500 runs); model M4 for asynchronous enforcement with negative controls; proof-of-concept concurrency and failure tests (v3 implementation with switchable fixes); cryptographic re-analysis and queueing model with bursty arrivals; attacker-profile experiment; clean-checkout reproduction of v1.0.0; manuscript, supplementary material, response to reviewers and a SHA-256 manifest of every file.

Scope: all control-effectiveness probabilities are modelling assumptions, all risk-score distributions are synthetic, benchmarks were measured on a shared server VM, and no industrial measurement or deployment is included.
